summary: Describes how IPv6 can be deployed in IEEE 802.16 wireless broadband networks next to existing IPv4 services. It covers the main components of IPv6 802.16 access networks, how they differ from IPv4 ones, and how IPv6 is integrated in each 802.16 technology. It is informational.

eli5.summary: This paper is a how-to for adding the newer internet addresses to wireless broadband networks while the older addresses still keep working.
